name: router_get_plan
description: Read the router's current plan for this session: level, team roles with model/effort/step, and the latest subtasks. Read-only; never opens a request. Use after compaction or resume, or before a re-dispatch.

name: router_report_triage
description: Report the lead's own size judgement for the current request. Recorded for calibration; may re-plan upward only, before the first subtask is dispatched.

name: router_report_result
description: Report a review verdict on a finished subtask (adds the review signal). A reject counts as one failure of the slot; two in a row raise it.

name: router_request_escalation
description: Ask the router to raise a finished subtask's slot one step when verify passed but the result is wrong. Shares the 3-raise-per-slot limit; a tier crossing or a second lead-only raise needs a user turn.

name: router_request_scope
description: Widen or narrow a pending/running subtask's write scope. Ordinary globs apply live; protected paths need a user turn; .git, .agentic-router and credential paths are never grantable.
